decisions.effect: Aliases retained for same Business, never reusable by another Business, blocked when Business Disabled

decisions.question: Should each built-in section type appear only once on a business page, or can Admin add multiple sections of the same type?
decisions.effect: Hero/Contact/Social/Payments/Location/Hours/Reviews/Custom Links at most one each; show/hide/reorder; no page builder

decisions.question: How should Admin enter business opening hours in the first release?
decisions.effect: Seven days, closed or multiple intervals, Business timezone; no holidays/open-now v1

decisions.question: vision.md includes both contact fields and typed WhatsApp links. Which source of truth should contact buttons use?
